title: Stage aging SLAs become team data on the axis, not per-browser storage
deviations_from_card: Per the coordinator's update, the axis layer lives in app/_lib/aging-policy.ts slaForStage (the r02 one aging clock) instead of a parallel resolver; board chip, sidebar badge (attention.ts, unedited) and the automation pass's agingTier (so the Python feed alerts) all follow the team slaDays (pinned by a listActiveEntriesForAutomation case; AgingTierSyncTest literals untouched, pytest -k 'automation or aging' 176 passed). Write set grew by: app/_lib/aging-policy.ts (coordinator-directed), app/_lib/stage-sla.ts (the pure module the card-named stage-sla.test.ts exercises: applyStageSla / slaOverridesFromAxis / pendingLocalAdoption), app/features/hiring/pipeline/PipelinePopulatedBoard.tsx (+4 prop lines to hand the editor the save error and the adoption offer), and pipelineBoardStorage.test.ts (writeStoredSla replaced by clearStoredSla). Shrunk: pipelineTypes.ts untouched (it only re-exports from aging-policy.ts). The 3 of 16 cases green before were vacuous refusals (the old schema rejected any unknown key). Added beyond the card: setStageRole drops slaDays when a column is turned terminal (else the composer save would be refused). Editor commits on blur/Enter, not per keystroke.
notes: Full test:unit exit 1 on files NOT mine, all siblings' uncommitted work at run time: loading-gap-debt.test.ts (DevTabCasesView.tsx), devcase-ledger.test.ts (FLAKE), candidateMatrixContracts.test.ts (profile). error-response-contract.test.ts initially flagged my route (detail: error.message) - fixed before commit, now green. test:perf exit 1 only in the working tree: 8 route overages come from siblings' uncommitted db/profiles.ts / db/analyses.ts / require-operator growth; measured on a detached worktree of committed HEAD c735d79fb (which includes this card) no route is over (letter 3039/3046, interview-kit 3029/3034, jds/generate 3015/3021, stage-sla route 604 KB), only the known job-ingest.ts 402/400 line - so no perf-budget change. api-reference.md: api:docs also emitted a row for the sibling's STAGED-but-uncommitted app/api/devcase/[id]/route.ts; that row was left out of my docs commit (248 routes), the devcase-workspace builder owes it. Capability TIGHTEN (critic note): a viewer seat without pipeline:write can no longer tune cadences (403 FORBIDDEN_CAPABILITY, shown in the editor via useErrorMessage); stated in docs/features/pipeline/README.md. attention.ts comments (lines ~31-33, ~91-93) still say the badge approximates browser overrides with role defaults - now stale, left because acceptance required no edit to that file; a one-line comment fix is owed. pipelineStageFilter.test.ts:121 pin (slaForStage(e.stage, slaOverrides, board.axis)) kept by preserving the call shape; slaOverrides is now only the optimistic value between a save and the board reload. Not browser-verified in either theme (UI is token/recipe-only: BTN_SECONDARY/BTN_GHOST, text-red-700 already dark-mapped).
